groups.context_line: You will hear part of a lecture about how seed banks store and check plant seeds.
groups.instructions: Complete the flow-chart below. Write NO MORE THAN TWO WORDS AND/OR A NUMBER for each answer.
groups.word_limit: NO MORE THAN TWO WORDS AND/OR A NUMBER
groups.stem_block:
GETTING A WILD SEED SAMPLE INTO A SEED BANK

IN THE FIELD
Not more than a fifth of the ripe seed is taken, and the material is kept
(1) ........ until it reaches the store
↓
DRYING
Slow drying in a warm, dry room brings the seed down to about five per cent moisture
↓
SEALING AND FREEZING
The quality of the seal counts for more than the jar itself. This bank runs its store
colder than the international standard, at minus (2) ........
↓
CHECKING
X-ray picks out the hollow seeds, then two hundred of them are germinated
↓
RETESTING
If a later test falls short, the sample is grown on and a bigger crop is taken — the step
banks call regeneration. A little is lost each time: the speaker calls a seed bank a
(3) ........ that fades whenever it is copied
↓
DUPLICATION
A portion put aside at the start travels to a (4) ........, in another country
if that can be managed

items.prompt: Not more than a fifth of the ripe seed is taken, and the material is kept (1) ........ until it reaches the store
items.evidence: keep the seed from each plant separate until it reaches the store
items.explanation: Seed collected in the field is kept plant by plant: the seed from each plant stays separate until it reaches the store, where it can be combined.

yeniden_uretim.uretilen_grup: P-FC-01 cerceve (dinleme alistirma / flow chart completion)
yeniden_uretim.eski_cerceve: Not more than a fifth of the ripe seed is taken, and the seed of every plant is kept (1) ........ all the way to the store
yeniden_uretim.eski_stem_block_satiri:
Not more than a fifth of the ripe seed is taken, and the seed of every plant
is kept (1) ........ all the way to the store
yeniden_uretim.neden_elendi: cerceveden okunuyordu: 'her bitkinin tohumu depoya kadar (1) tutulur' — 'her bitkinin' ifadesi ornek butunlugu mantigini kurup tek doldurmayi birakiyordu; konusma duyulmadan 3/3 turda yazildi.
yeniden_uretim.ne_degisti: 'Her bitkinin tohumu' ifadesi cerceveden cikarildi; satir artik yalnizca 'malzeme depoya varana kadar (1) tutulur' diyor ve bu cerceveye 'dry', 'cool', 'labelled', 'sealed' gibi adaylar da (asagidaki KURUTMA adimi yuzunden ozellikle 'dry') en az cevap kadar oturuyor. Ayrim konusmacinin 'keep the seed from each plant separate until it reaches the store' cumlesine tasindi. Cevap, kanit ve turn_index degismedi.
yeniden_uretim.kaynak_prompt: denetim turu: dinleme alistirma yazim kusurlari (2026-08-18)

items.prompt: This bank runs its store colder than the international standard, at minus (2) ........
items.evidence: Our own store runs colder than the standard, at minus thirty
items.distractor_used: minus 20 (the international standard) / minus 18 (the old domestic-freezer figure)
items.explanation: Minus twenty is the international standard and minus eighteen the old domestic-freezer figure, but the speaker's own store is run at minus thirty, because the power supply is intermittent and the extra ten degrees buy about three days of grace when a compressor stops.

yeniden_uretim.neden_elendi: Kor olcumde 3/3 bilindi: tohum bankasi depolama sicakligi eksi 20 derece, alanin yerlesik standardi. Senaryodaki 'eksi 18' rakibi yanlis yone isaret ettigi icin ise yaramiyordu.
yeniden_uretim.ne_degisti: Recete 2+3. Tur 5 yerinde genisletildi (tur sayisi ayni): standart eksi yirmi olarak ANILIYOR ama konusmacinin kendi deposu eksi otuzda calisiyor, gerekcesiyle birlikte. Kor cozucunun uretecegi 'yirmi' seste acikca baska bir seye ait. Tur 5'e bagli sinav kalemi L3 ozet #34 (yuzde 6) korundu.
yeniden_uretim.not: Kok metninden 'minus twenty' ifadesi cikarildi: (a) capraz tarama bunu L5 cumle tamamlama #27'nin cevabi ('20') ile cakisiyor diye rapora sokuyordu, (b) standardin kokte yazili olmasi, standardi bilen adayin 'on derece daha soguk' turu bir cikarim yapmasina kapi araliyordu. Standart yalniz seste kaliyor.

items.prompt: A little is lost each time: the speaker calls a seed bank a (3) ........ that fades whenever it is copied
items.evidence: A seed bank is less a photograph than a photograph that fades a little every time you copy it.
items.explanation: Every regeneration selects a little — some seeds fail, some cross with the neighbouring row — so the speaker says a seed bank is less a photograph than a photograph that fades a little every time you copy it.

yeniden_uretim.neden_elendi: Kor olcumde 3/3 bilindi: 'ornegi yeniden yetistirip taze tohum almak' isleminin adi tohum bankaciliginda tek ve yerlesik terim.
yeniden_uretim.ne_degisti: Recete 1. 'regeneration' semada verili bilgiye cevrildi; bosluk tur 8'e kaydirildi (yeni cevap noktasi L3-S4-32): konusmacinin benzetmesi. Kor cozucunun 'her kopyalandiginda solan sey' icin uretecegi ilk sozcuk 'photocopy'; seste gecen sozcuk 'photograph'. Tur 8'e bagli sinav kalemi L3 kisa cevap #37 ('the neighbouring row') korundu.

items.prompt: A portion put aside at the start travels to a (4) ........, in another country if that can be managed
items.evidence: a duplicate goes to a second site, in a different country wherever that can be arranged
items.explanation: The backup copy is not kept in the same building; the portion set aside at the start is sent to a second site, in another country if possible.

groups.context_line: You will hear a lecturer talking about plastics in the sea and about how they are measured.
groups.instructions: Complete the flow-chart below. Write NO MORE THAN TWO WORDS AND/OR A NUMBER for each answer.
groups.word_limit: NO MORE THAN TWO WORDS AND/OR A NUMBER
groups.stem_block:
PLASTIC IN THE SEA: WHAT GOES IN, WHAT WE FIND

ANNUAL INPUT
Revised upwards once better waste figures became available
↓
SURFACE SEARCH
Everything floating that surveys can locate adds up to something like
(5) ........ of one per cent of the estimated input
↓
SINKING
Sunlight and moving water break the pieces up; a coat of organisms then weighs
each piece down, and the people who do the counting call that step (6) ........
↓
SAMPLING
A net is towed alongside the vessel. The finest nets the speaker trusts,
(7) ........ of a millimetre, return several times as many particles
↓
WHAT WOULD HELP FIRST
Design: with fewer different polymers in one item, (8) ........ becomes practicable

items.prompt: Everything floating that surveys can locate adds up to something like (5) ........ of one per cent of the estimated input
items.evidence: accounts for perhaps a quarter of one per cent of what we think has gone in
items.distractor_used: one per cent (the figure quoted everywhere)
items.explanation: The one per cent everyone quotes was worked out against the old eight-million input and coarse nets; set against eleven million and the finer nets, the speaker puts the surface share at a quarter of one per cent.

yeniden_uretim.neden_elendi: Kor olcumde 3/3 bilindi: deniz plastigi yazininin taninmis 'kayip plastik' orani yuzde bir.
yeniden_uretim.ne_degisti: Recete 2+3. Tur 4 yerinde degistirildi (tur sayisi ayni): konusmaci yuzde biri acikca reddediyor ('sekiz milyonluk eski girdiye ve kaba aglara gore dogruydu'), kendi rakami ceyrek. Cerceve '(5) of one per cent' oldu, cevap 'a quarter'. Tur 4'e bagli sinav kalemi L5 tablo #34 (11 milyon ton) korundu.

items.prompt: a coat of organisms then weighs each piece down, and the people who do the counting call that step (6) ........
items.evidence: the people who do the counting say ballasting
items.explanation: Biofouling is the textbook word for the film itself; the speaker says the people who do the counting call the weighing-down step ballasting, because it is the added weight and not the fouling that makes the particle sink.

yeniden_uretim.neden_elendi: L5 ozet paketinin verili metni 'leave the polymer brittle enough to break apart' diyerek cevabi duz yaziyordu.
yeniden_uretim.ne_degisti: Recete 1+3. Bosluk ayni turun (6) baska bir cevap noktasina kaydirildi (L5-S4-12 -> L5-S4-13) ve o nokta sesli rakiple kuruldu: 'the textbooks call that biofouling, but the people who do the counting say ballasting'. 'brittle' artik semada verili bilgi. Ayni turdaki sinav kalemi L5 ozet #36 ('scoured') ve onun 'that film' oncülü korundu.

items.prompt: The finest nets the speaker trusts, (7) ........ of a millimetre, return several times as many particles
items.evidence: the surveys I would actually trust have gone finer still, to a twentieth
items.distractor_used: a tenth of a millimetre (a good deal of recent work) / a third of a millimetre (most surveys)
items.explanation: Most surveys use a third of a millimetre and a good deal of recent work a tenth, but the surveys the speaker trusts have gone finer still, to a twentieth.

yeniden_uretim.neden_elendi: Kor olcumde 3/3 bilindi: mikroplastik orneklemesinde ince agin yerlesik olcusu (0,1 mm).
yeniden_uretim.ne_degisti: Recete 2. Tur 7 yerinde degistirildi: 'a tenth' artik sadece yaygin uygulama, konusmacinin guvendigi taramalar 'a twentieth'. Cevap 'a twentieth', celdirici olarak hem 'a third' hem 'a tenth' seste duruyor. Ayni turdaki sinav kalemi L5 ozet #37 (kirk dakika) korundu.

items.prompt: Design: with fewer different polymers in one item, (8) ........ becomes practicable
items.evidence: so that sorting is possible at all
items.explanation: The measure the speaker trusts most is design: sorting only becomes possible once a product contains fewer different polymers.

groups.context_line: You will hear part of a lecture about noise pollution, how it is measured and how it can be reduced.
groups.instructions: Complete the flow-chart below. Write NO MORE THAN TWO WORDS AND/OR A NUMBER for each answer.
groups.word_limit: NO MORE THAN TWO WORDS AND/OR A NUMBER
groups.stem_block:
ROAD NOISE: FROM MAP TO REMEDY

STRATEGIC MAP
Predicted rather than measured: among the figures fed in are vehicle numbers,
speeds, building heights and ground (9) ........
↓
WHERE THE SOUND COMES FROM
Under about forty kilometres an hour it is the engine; faster than that it is the
tyre on the road — which is why an electric car is quiet in a car park and no
quieter at all on a (10) ........
↓
AT THE SOURCE
Open-textured asphalt: (11) ........ to four decibels on a road that is no longer new
A limit dropped from fifty to thirty buys two to three decibels for almost nothing
↓
ALONG THE PATH
A wall or an earth bund, set where it hides the wheels from view
↓
AT THE RECEIVER
Secondary glazing: what the catalogues sell is the thickness of the glass, but under
(12) ........ millimetres of gap between the panes very little is bought

items.prompt: Predicted rather than measured: among the figures fed in are vehicle numbers, speeds, building heights and ground (9) ........
items.evidence: traffic counts, speeds, the heights of the buildings and the hardness of the ground
items.explanation: Noise maps are produced by modelling rather than measurement; the inputs fed into the model include traffic counts, speeds, building heights and the hardness of the ground.

items.prompt: which is why an electric car is quiet in a car park and no quieter at all on a (10) ........
items.evidence: they are quiet in a car park and no quieter at all on a bypass
items.explanation: Above about forty kilometres an hour the tyre-road contact dominates, so an electric car is quiet in a car park and, as the speaker puts it, no quieter at all on a bypass.

yeniden_uretim.neden_elendi: Kor olcumde 3/3 bilindi: belli bir hizin uzerinde yol gurultusunun lastik-yol temasindan geldigi ders kitabi bilgisi; ayrica L4 akis semasi sinav kaleminin verili metni 'noise made in the tyre tread' diyor.
yeniden_uretim.ne_degisti: Recete 1. Senaryo degismedi; bosluk ayni turun (6) baska bir cevap noktasina kaydirildi (L4-S4-16 -> L4-S4-17). 'tyre' artik semada verili bilgi, sorulan sey konusmacinin kendi sozcugu: 'no quieter at all on a bypass'.

items.prompt: Open-textured asphalt: (11) ........ to four decibels on a road that is no longer new
items.evidence: three to four is a more honest figure
items.explanation: Open-textured asphalt is often quoted at five decibels; once the pores fill, the realistic gain drops to three to four decibels.

items.prompt: Secondary glazing: what the catalogues sell is the thickness of the glass, but under (12) ........ millimetres of gap between the panes very little is bought
items.evidence: under a hundred millimetres of gap you are buying very little
items.distractor_used: the thickness of the glass (what the catalogues sell)
items.explanation: The catalogues sell secondary glazing on the thickness of the glass, but the speaker says it is the width of the gap that does the work, and under a hundred millimetres of gap very little is bought.

yeniden_uretim.neden_elendi: 'Sicak gecede acilan sey' boslugu tek dogal cevaba (pencere) kapaniyordu; ses gerekmiyordu.
yeniden_uretim.ne_degisti: Recete 1+2. Bosluk ayni turun (11) baska bir cevap noktasina kaydirildi (L4-S4-28 -> L4-S4-27) ve o noktaya yerinde bir esik degeri verildi: 'every catalogue sells you on the thickness of the glass, but it is the width of the gap between the panes that does the work — under a hundred millimetres of gap you are buying very little'. Tur 11'e bagli sinav kalemi L4 akis semasi #40 ('bedrooms') korundu.

groups.context_line: You will hear a lecturer talking about behavioural economics and how findings from it are tested in the field.
groups.instructions: Complete the flow-chart below. Write NO MORE THAN TWO WORDS AND/OR A NUMBER for each answer.
groups.word_limit: NO MORE THAN TWO WORDS AND/OR A NUMBER
groups.stem_block:
FROM A LABORATORY FINDING TO A TESTED POLICY

THE DEFAULT
Automatic enrolment lifts membership of a workplace saving scheme sharply,
though the paperwork is identical in both directions
↓
WHY IT WORKS — THREE SEPARATE REASONS
1 (13) ........ : even the smallest obstacle cuts down how many people come through
2 the quiet message that this is what is normally done
3 the form put off, and then put off again
↓
WHEN THE SAME TOOL IS TURNED ROUND
Whoever picks the default has interests of their own, and the technique that helps you
save can keep you subscribed to something you no longer want — an (14) ........
rather than a nudge
↓
THE METHOD NOW
A field experiment on real customers, allocated at random to one wording or
another, with samples running into (15) ........ of thousands

items.prompt: 1 (13) ........ : even the smallest obstacle cuts down how many people come through
items.evidence: The first is effort: any small obstacle, however trivial, thins out the people who get to the other side of it.
items.explanation: The first reason a form makes such a difference is effort: however trivial it is, every small obstacle cuts down the number of people who get through.

items.prompt: the technique that helps you save can keep you subscribed to something you no longer want — an (14) ........ rather than a nudge
items.evidence: an obstacle course rather than a nudge
items.explanation: The fourth criticism: whoever chooses the default has interests of their own, and the same technique that helps you save can keep you subscribed to something you no longer want — what the speaker calls an obstacle course rather than a nudge.

yeniden_uretim.neden_elendi: 'tek bir kasabada tek bir (14)' cercevesi tek dogal sozcuge kapaniyordu; ayrica tur 7 zaten iki baska kaleme (sinav ozet #37 ve alistirma not #15) bagliydi.
yeniden_uretim.ne_degisti: Recete 1. Bosluk tur 9'a kaydirildi (yeni cevap noktasi L6-S4-38): konusmacinin dorduncu elestiride kullandigi ifade. Alanin yerlesik terimi ('sludge') seste GECMIYOR, konusmacinin sozcugu 'obstacle course' — kor cozucunun ureteceginden farkli. Tur 9'a bagli sinav kalemi L6 ozet #39 ('goals') semada ANILMADI.

items.prompt: A field experiment on real customers, allocated at random to one wording or another, with samples running into (15) ........ of thousands
items.evidence: with sample sizes in the tens of thousands
items.explanation: The method that changed the field is the field experiment: sample sizes are measured in the tens of thousands, not the sixty students in early laboratory studies.
